method: Team needs v1.3, box-score only. Four Factors (Oliver) + minutes-weighted rotation skill profile, star-anchored need weights, concave FitGain vs the team's current skill level, QualityGain vs the team's rotation-average RPR. TradeScore = QualityGain + 2 * FitGain - AvailabilityDiscount (v1.3: fit counts double, so the list is team-specific, not a global quality ranking; the weight is hand-set, not fitted). No displaced player: removed Nov 21, 2026 at Ron's request. RPR here is RPR v1.2 (headline since 28 Nov 2026): ORtg shrunk toward the league average (K = 200 possessions used) and opponent-adjusted (OppAdj K = 150 in November), with the counting terms centered on the league-average per-36 rates, defense full-weighted, no minutes shrink and no minutes floor; rpr_v13, rpr_v1 and rpr_v1_1 are the parallel/old values. Bench scoring is percentile-ranked bench-only and the team bench skill is bench-only; perimeter defence is STL plus half-weight BLK per 36. The usage penalty was removed in v1.1 (it never bound). Each team also gets a top_distinct list: its best targets who do not top many other teams' lists, shown first on the team pages; top_overall is the best available role players, labelled as such. Target age (ESPN roster pull) is shown with each target; age is display only, it does not change the score. Availability filter: only Rotation / depth, Elite role player, Undervalued / buy-low and High-value starter tiers; top-3 RPR players on their own team excluded; target under 55% Min, under 30 MPG, under 26% usage, under 20 PPG. Teams whose highest-RPR qualifying player is under RPR 1.5 are labelled no clear star in this data. Salaries are display only in v1 (fetch_salaries.py, Basketball-Reference contracts, fetched 2026-11-28, 407 of 476 players matched, never invented): each target shows its 2026-27 salary, and RPR and TradeScore per $1M. They do not change TradeScore or the ranking. Team payrolls are BBRef team totals. The NBA is a soft cap and matching rules are complex (a team over the first apron can generally only take back 100% of the salary it sends out, a team over the second apron cannot aggregate salaries in a trade), so a salary shown here does not prove a trade is legal. No lineup/tracking data: this is a box-score fit, a prior for lineup data, not a lineup prediction.
